name: word-atlas-android
description: Word Atlas 词光 — Android port (Capacitor shell around the upstream web app)

scripts.test: node --import tsx --test src/store/srs.test.ts src/store/store.test.ts src/lib/text.test.ts src/lib/typing.test.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write src vite.config.ts capacitor.config.ts scripts/android/*.mjs package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:android && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && npm run android:patch && npm run android:media && node scripts/android/gradle.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && npm run android:patch && npm run android:media && node scripts/android/gradle.mjs assembleRelease
